paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar (red-giant tip) bound on axion-electron coupling. g13 = gae/1e-13. NGC 4258: g13<1.58 (95% CL) => gae<1.58e-13; omega Centauri: g13<1.29 => gae<1.29e-13. Abstract states gae<1.6e-13 (NGC 4258) and gae<1.3e-13 (omega Cen). This is a stellar cooling bound, not a DM haloscope, so it is essentially mass-independent for sub-keV axions; mass set to 0 as placeholder. Paper also gives neutrino dipole moment bounds but primary particle coupling result extracted is AxionElectron.
